services.name: Track Rental
services.desc: Coming off the starting grid onto the track just beyond the start/finish line we accelerate up to 3rd gear and move to the far-right headed for turn one. This is a medium-fast turn so we brake lightly, turn into the late apex and accelerating let the car drift across the road touching the edge at the end of the concrete curb. It is important to be right on the apex in this turn. The outside of the turn has a slight reverse camber to it. An early apex in this turn can send us into the daisies if we’re carrying any speed at all.
